lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg12Al2Co2 (reduced formula Mg6AlCo) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows all Al, Co, and Mg centers in 12-coordinate, close-packed-like local arrangements, with Mg–Mg distances ranging from about 2.88 to 3.24 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 16 sites, and validated coordination-polyhedron contacts reveal Mg–Mg and Co–Mg polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces.
